name: SONA student membership (Australian Institute of Architects)
summary: Student membership of SONA, the student body of the Australian Institute of Architects, for architecture students.
who: Students enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in a recognised architecture or related course in Australia
Students on a one-year deferral are also eligible
how: Complete the online application form and payment.
